about: Translation eval set for the demo tool Kestrel Studio (spec section 19), complete at 40. Groups, targets and pass bars are the spec's. Plain (20): p01-p15 and m01-m03 from the E4 pilot, p16-p17 added in Phase 1. Pairs (6): pairWith names the other wording; both must map to the same keys. Outside (6): expected null = must be marked unsupported (never a Yes); e01 is blank. Injection (5): plain names the plain question with the same keys, where there is one. Environment (3): the model's job is the keys; `verdicts` are what the engine must answer on the spec's demo data (section 16, Priya), checked offline in test/unit/eval-set.test.ts.

plain.bar: at least 90% exact keys and values

pair.bar: both of a pair map to the same keys

injection.bar: same keys as the plain version

environment.bar: the expected different verdicts in Dev and Prod
